papers.title: Selective laser melting of Al–8.5Fe–1.3V–1.7Si alloy: Investigation on the resultant microstructure and hardness
papers.abstract: This article presents the microstructure and hardness variation of an Al–8.5Fe–1.3V–1.7Si (wt%, FVS0812) alloy after selective laser melting (SLM) modification. Three zones were distinguished across the melting pool of the SLM-processed FVS0812 alloy: the laser melted zone (LMZ), the melting pool border, and the heat affected zone (HAZ) in the previously deposited area around the melting pool. Inside the LMZ, either an extremely fine cellular-dendritic structure or a mixture zone of the α-Al matrix and nanoscale Al12(Fe,V)3Si particles appeared. With a decreased laser beam scanning speed, the cellular-dendritic structure zone within the LMZ shrank significantly while the mixture zone expanded. The α-Al and Al12(Fe,V)3Si mixture zone was also observed in the HAZ, but another phase, submicron θ-Al13Fe4 particles with rectangular or hexagonal shapes, formed along the melting pool border. Microhardness tests indicated that the hardness of the SLM-processed FVS0812 samples far exceeded that of the as-cast FVS0812 alloy.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的Al-Fe-V-Si合金非生物医用材料，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies a non-biomedical aluminum alloy for aerospace, with no porous structure, fatigue testing, or biomedical context relevant to implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺对Al-Fe-V-Si合金微观组织和硬度的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用不同扫描速度进行SLM成形，分析熔池内组织演变。
summary_zh.result: SLM后硬度远超铸态，且扫描速度降低使细晶区缩小、混合区扩大。
summary_zh.validation: 显微硬度测试验证力学性能提升。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of selective laser melting parameters on the microstructure and hardness of an Al-Fe-V-Si alloy.
summary_en.method: SLM was performed at varying scanning speeds, and the microstructure across the melt pool was characterized.
summary_en.result: The SLM-processed alloy exhibited significantly higher hardness than the as-cast alloy, with lower scanning speeds reducing the cellular-dendritic zone and expanding the mixture zone.
summary_en.validation: Microhardness testing was used to compare the mechanical properties of SLM-processed and as-cast samples.
